metadata.title: CapRover vs Coolify, Dokploy and Dokku
metadata.description: See why developers choose CapRover for a focused, self-hosted Docker platform with a web dashboard, NGINX control, one-click apps and Docker Swarm scaling.

hero.title: Start simple. Never hit a ceiling.
hero.intro: CapRover gives you the easy path for everyday deployments and direct access to the underlying NGINX and Docker configuration when an advanced workload needs it. Run your apps, not a platform team.

resourceDescription: CapRover documents a 1 GB RAM minimum. Coolify and Dokploy each document 2 GB RAM and 30 GB of free storage, leaving CapRover with a lower published starting requirement.

shortVersion.title: CapRover keeps the common path easy without removing advanced control.
shortVersion.description: The table emphasizes concrete capabilities that support that promise. Short notes identify prerequisites and important limitations without turning every cell into a competitor brochure.

oneOnOne.title: Compare CapRover with the alternative you are considering.
oneOnOne.description: Each page highlights CapRover's strengths, documents the meaningful tradeoffs and links every technical claim to official documentation.
